name: Stanley Reagan
fact: Reagan sat on the Interhall Council in 1985-86, the year after he chaired the Associated Student Government Rules and Elections Committee. He was a public relations major from Tompkinsville and graduated in 1986.

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 196, Interhall Council group photograph and caption, and p. 314, senior class portraits

name: Jon LeTendre
fact: LeTendre was a Sigma Chi, photographed in the fraternity front row in the 1986 Talisman, and sat in the College Republicans the following year.

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 269, Sigma Chi group photograph; 1987 Talisman, p. 120, College Republicans

name: Happy Chandler
fact: Chandler resigned the Associated Student Government vice presidency in January 1984, part-way through the term. The Herald reported the resignation under his given name, William Chandler.

src.label: Herald, 12 January 1984, Victoria Malmer, "Associated Student Government Vice President William Chandler Quits"

name: Gil Cowles
fact: Cowles was a Bowling Green freshman in 1980-81 and a pre-veterinary major, one of four students employed to live and work at the university Agriculture Exposition Center. He had shown cattle in 4-H for about ten years.

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 170, Becky Suiter, "Caretaking not haymaking"
